summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd., a foreign private issuer, under cover of Form 20-F. The filing provides a link to an audio recording of the company's earnings call for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, held on May 12, 2026. It includes a letter to stock exchanges (NSE, BSE, NYSE, NSE IFSC) pursuant to SEBI listing regulations. The filing is a routine periodic report. No special situation, transaction, or material corporate action is disclosed.
